newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: RESEARCH ALERT - Bank Austria upgraded to strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bank Austria upgraded to strong buy.

text.p: The preference shares of Austrian market leader Bank Austria have been upgraded to a "strong buy" from "buy", Salomon Brothers said in a research recommendation published on Wednesday.
"Measured by earnings and net asset multiples, the Bank Austria preference shares are one of the cheapest shares in our West European coverage," analyst Matthew Czepliewicz said.
"Investors who have booked healthy gains in the German banks should consider rotating some of those gains into Bank Austria, liquidity allowing," he said.
Bank Austria took over number two bank Creditanstalt in January. Creditanstalt reports its earnings for the first half on Friday, while Bank Austria reports its first half on July 28.
"Generally speaking, operating profits for each of the banks should be up more than 20 percent before provisioning, more than 25 percent after provisioning," Czepliewicz said.

"Though these figures may not seem exceptional in what has been a strong first half for European banks, the healthy results are expected to continue over the next 3-4 years, something that cannot be said of European banking in general."

Czepliewicz said the integration of Bank Austria and Creditanstalt appeared to be proceeding a little faster than expected and that this was also the case with the streamlining of the capital structure. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12254
